{
  "name": "green-ecolution-frontend",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.7.0",
  "license": "AGPL-3.0-only",
  "scripts": {
    "preinstall": "npx only-allow pnpm",
    "start": "pnpm build && pnpm preview",
    "dev": "pnpm --filter frontend dev",
    "dev:remote": "VITE_BACKEND_BASEURL=/api-stage pnpm --filter frontend dev",
    "build": "pnpm --filter=!frontend --filter=!@green-ecolution/demo-plugin -r build && pnpm --filter frontend build",
    "build:stage": "pnpm --filter=!frontend --filter=!@green-ecolution/demo-plugin -r build && pnpm --filter frontend build:stage",
    "build:backend-client": "pnpm --filter backend-client build",
    "build:plugin-interface": "pnpm --filter plugin-interface build",
    "build:ui": "pnpm --filter @green-ecolution/ui build",
    "generate": "pnpm --filter backend-client generate",
    "generate:stage": "pnpm --filter backend-client generate:stage",
    "generate:local": "pnpm --filter backend-client generate:local",
    "ci": "pnpm --filter backend-client generate:ci",
    "lint": "prettier --check . && pnpm --filter='!green-ecolution-frontend' -r lint",
    "lint:ui": "pnpm --filter @green-ecolution/ui lint",
    "test": "pnpm --filter frontend test:run && pnpm run test:packages",
    "test:packages": "pnpm --filter plugin-interface test:run && pnpm --filter @green-ecolution/demo-plugin test:run",
    "preview": "pnpm --filter frontend preview",
    "fmt": "prettier --write .",
    "storybook": "pnpm --filter @green-ecolution/ui storybook",
    "build-storybook": "pnpm --filter @green-ecolution/ui build-storybook"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "prettier": "^3.9.6",
---
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.20.0"
}
---
32:# recipe and the CI job must stay on the same pin. TYPST_VERSION and TYPST_SHA256
34:ARG TYPST_VERSION=0.15.1
38:        "https://github.com/typst/typst/releases/download/v${TYPST_VERSION}/typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz" \

observation.command: head -30 frontend/package.json; echo ---; grep -E "engines|packageManager" -A3 frontend/package.json; echo ---; grep -rn "TYPST_VERSION" frontend/Dockerfile
